Application.Text12:
protocol_records:
record_id: A126-P001
title: 分离视网膜的改进 SUMIC 标记与清除
record_type: partially_reported_workflow
purpose: 为来源研究的固定视网膜空间成像保存实际操作。
applicability: 
  sample: isolated rat retina
  whole_eyeball_scope: 论文亦展示 whole-eyeball imaging，但本文主流程的摘除范围不自动赋给整眼球路线。
start_state: 来源研究离体眼球；固定后分离视网膜。
end_state: 标记后在 ECi/PEGM 中透明的视网膜。
provenance: 
  source: original publisher HTML Sec22 and supplementary Fig6
  original_protocol_workbook: null (as recorded in source)
materials: 
  [1] PFA; FAS G1109; agarose
  [2] PBS; urea; glycerol; Triton X-100; FBS
  [3] donkey serum; DMSO; source-listed antibodies
  [4] isopropanol; ECi; PEGM
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 本段只含常规固定组织处理。来源冲突不按偏好解决。
  [2] 直接偶联与需二抗的分支分开；切片 immunostaining 与 wholemount 条件不互相覆盖。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A126-P001-SEC01
    title: 固定、组织支持与前处理
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A126-P001-S01
        title: 固定并分离视网膜
        action: 取离体眼球，以 4% PFA 固定 4 h，再去除角膜、巩膜、晶状体和脉络膜，保留视网膜。固定温度有不同来源写法，不能统一为一值。
        parameters: 
          PFA: 4%
          duration: 4 h
          main_text_temperature: not specified
          S6a_temperature: ice-cold
          S6b_temperature: RT
          removed_parts: 
            [1] cornea
            [2] sclera
            [3] lens
            [4] choroid
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec22
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
          [2]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p7, Supplementary Fig6a/b
        missing_information: 
          [1] 本步骤明确是分离视网膜支线；整眼球图像的具体组织保留/去除方案不由此自动推定。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A126-P001-S02
        title: FAS 处理
        action: 以来源所列商用 FAS 处理视网膜。正文和 S6b 是 10 min；S6a 时间栏为 3 min。
        parameters: 
          reagent: FAS, Servicebio G1109
          main_duration: 10 min
          S6b: 10 min, RT
          S6a: 3 min
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec22
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
          [2]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p7, Supplementary Fig6a/b
        missing_information: 
          [1] FAS 全配方/浓度未报告；不能按名称猜配方。时长冲突保留。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A126-P001-S03
        title: 琼脂糖支持与 PBS 洗
        action: 包埋于 3% agarose gel，随后温和 PBS 清洗。
        parameters: 
          agarose: 3%, Macklin9012-36-6
          wash: gentle PBS wash
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec22
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
          [2]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p7, Supplementary Fig6a/b
        missing_information: 
          [1] agarose 百分比基准、包埋温度、洗液量/次数/时长未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [4]         step_id: A126-P001-S04
        title: 来源称 antigen retrieval 的缓冲处理
        action: 置于含 urea、glycerol、Triton X-100 的缓冲液，4 °C 处理 6–12 h。
        parameters: 
          urea: 25%, U5128
          glycerol: 15%, G7893
          Triton_X100: 7%
          temperature: 4 °C
          duration: 6–12 h
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec22
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
          [2]             source_id: F03

[]

        title: FBS 清洗
        action: 用 PBS 中的 2% FBS 洗两次，每次 5 min。

          vehicle: PBS
          repeat: 2
          duration_each: 5 min
        source_refs:

            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
        missing_information:

[]

        title: 封闭
        action: 用含驴血清、DMSO 和 Triton 的封闭液，37 °C 处理 20 min。

        missing_information:

        legacy_rows: 
[]
  [2]     section_id: A126-P001-SEC02
    title: 标记与清除
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A126-P001-S07
        title: 一抗或直接标记试剂
        action: 按图面所示靶点使用 Table2 目录的试剂；用本文 antibody solution 稀释，RT 过夜。S6a 将此阶段概括为 12 h，保留原时间表达。
        parameters: 
          dilution: 1:150
          antibody_solution: 2% v/v donkey serum,10% DMSO,0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS
          main_duration: overnight
          S6a_duration: 12 h
          temperature: RT
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec22
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
          [2]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p7, Supplementary Fig6a/b
        missing_information: 
          [1] 并非全部试剂同时共染；逐图面组合及未列目录靶点的信息待绑定。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A126-P001-S08
        title: 一抗后洗
        action: 在 washing buffer 中室温洗 3 h。
        parameters: 
          washing_buffer: 2% v/v donkey serum and0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS
          duration: 3 h
          temperature: RT
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec22
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
        missing_information: 
          [1] 换液次数、体积未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A126-P001-S09
        title: 仅未偶联一抗的二抗支线
        action: 对未偶联一抗，使用相同 antibody solution 孵育二抗 6 h、RT；随后用 washing buffer 在 37 °C 洗 3 h。直接偶联试剂不自动重复二抗。
        parameters: 
          condition: unconjugated primary antibodies only
          secondary_duration: 6 h
          secondary_temperature: RT
          secondary_vehicle: same antibody solution as S07
          post_secondary_wash: 3 h at37 °C in washing buffer
          secondary_dilution_reference: Supplementary Table3,1:300
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec22
            url: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41368-025-00414-3#Sec22
          [2]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p7, Supplementary Fig6a/b
          [3]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p15
        missing_information: 
          [1] 直接偶联分支是否同样执行这次 37 °C 洗，未单独交代。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [4]         step_id: A126-P001-S10
        title: 异丙醇脱水
        action: 在 RT 下依次用 30%、50%、80%、100% isopropanol，各 15 min。S6a 总栏写 1.25 h，与下列四次 15 min 不一致，不补额外第五次。
        parameters:

            [1] 30%
            [2] 50%
            [3] 80%
            [4] 100%
          duration_each: 15 min
          temperature: RT
          S6a_header: 1.25 h
          S6a_detail: 15 min ×4
        source_refs:

            locator: Sec22

[]

        title: H&E 切片观察
        action: 切 5 µm 片，H&E 染色，用 DM500 直立光学显微镜观察。

          thickness: 5 µm

          microscope: Leica DM500 upright optical

[]

    title: IHC 支线
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A126-P003-S03
        title: 独立 IHC 切片准备
        action: IHC 使用固定、石蜡包埋和切片材料；切片 60 °C 烘 30–60 min，之后进入该节所述处理。
        parameters: 
          input: fixed,paraffin-embedded sections
          baking: 60 °C,30–60 min
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec21
        missing_information: 
          [1] 该段未给固定浓度/时间、切片厚度和脱蜡细节，不能由 H&E 支线补成完整前缀。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A126-P003-S04
        title: IHC 切片处理与 PBS 洗
        action: 按原文组分量处理切片，然后 PBS 洗三次，每次 3 min。
        parameters: 
          mixture_as_reported: 
            PBS: 40 ml
            Triton_X100: 120 µl
            30%_H2O2_stock: 400 µl
          PBS_wash: 3 ×3 min
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec21
        missing_information: 
          [1] 处理时长/温度和最终体积未给；保留 stock 和加入量，不误写最终30% H2O2。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A126-P003-S05
        title: IHC citrate 修复
        action: 浸入 0.01 mol/L sodium citrate，以高功率微波加热 4 min 至沸，自然冷至 RT。
        parameters: 
          buffer: 0.01 mol/L sodium citrate,P4922 as printed
          heating: microwave high power,4 min until boiling
          cool: naturally to RT
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec21
        missing_information: 
          [1] pH、功率瓦数和冷却时长未知；不增加第二轮微波。
        legacy_rows: 
[]

        title: IHC 封闭和一抗
        action: 用与二抗宿主同种的血清在 37 °C 封闭 30 min，再加入稀释一抗，37 °C 1–2 h。
        parameters: 
          serum: same species as secondary antibody
          block: 37 °C,30 min
          primary: 37 °C,1–2 h
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec21
        missing_information:

        legacy_rows: 
[]

        title: IHC 二抗
        action: PBS 洗三次各 3 min，再加稀释二抗 37 °C 孵育 1–2 h；再 PBS 洗三次各 3 min。
        parameters: 
          pre_wash: PBS3×3 min
          secondary: 37 °C,1–2 h
          post_wash: PBS3×3 min
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec21

record_id: A126-P005
title: 荧光获取、三维表示及限定图像定量
record_type: partially_reported_readout_and_analysis

sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A126-P005-SEC01
    title: 来源所报操作
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A126-P005-S01
        title: 荧光获取与重建
        action: 来源列出 spinning-disk confocal 和 light-sheet 两种平台。按实际图像输入获取 Z-stack，按组保持各通道设置一致，Imaris 作 3D 重建。
        parameters: 
          instruments: 
            [1] Andor Dragonfly200 spinning-disk confocal
            [2] Miltenyi-LaVision UltraMicroscopeII light sheet
          laser_lines: 
            [1] 405 nm
            [2] 488 nm
            [3] 561 nm
            [4] 647 nm
          emission_filters: six filters spanning420–730 nm; exact bands not listed
          software: Imaris v9.7
          comparison_rule: same settings across experimental groups for each channel
          capability_list_only: 
            [1] panorama
            [2] manual extended focus
            [3] time-lapse
            [4] Z-stack
            [5] autofocus
            [6] auto-stitching

        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A126-P005-S02
        title: Surface/spot/filament 三种表示
        action: 分别按目的生成 Surface、Spot 或 Filament：先界定 ROI，surface 调阈值至满意；spots 按 mass/intensity 分型，手动删组织外点；filaments 设置 connective baseline bounds 并调阈值匹配血管体积。
        parameters: 
          surface: ROI; separate vascular/perivascular/stromal marker surfaces
          spots: mass/intensity classification; manual removal outside tissue
          filaments: bounds in connective baseline; threshold matched to vessel volume
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            locator: Sec24
        missing_information: 
          [1] 阈值、spot diameter、mass 定义、baseline 和误删规则未给；不是三个步骤每张图必需连续执行。

[]

        action: 用 Fiji 调阈值划定目标信号和选定区域面积，取面积比；另以血管体积/全器官组织体积定义来源的三维 vessel density。两种分母不可混为一值。
        parameters: 
          software: 
            [1] Imaris v9.7
            [2] Fiji v1.53q
          area_fraction: target signal area / total selected-region area
          area_outputs: 
            [1] FAF area
            [2] leakage area
            [3] perivascular signal percentage
          volume_density: vessel tissue volume / total whole-organ tissue volume
          artery_count_channel: α-SMA
          vessel_count_channel: Isolectin B4
          junction_and_branch_software: 
            [1] AngioTool
            [2] Imaris
        source_refs:

            locator: Sec25
          [2]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p.8
        missing_information:

        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [4]         step_id: A126-P005-S04
        title: 共定位
        action: 分离所需荧光通道，使用 Fiji Colocalization Finder 生成散点图及定量输出。
        parameters: 
          software: Fiji Colocalization Finder
          steps: 
            [1] open images
            [2] split channels
            [3] run Colocalization Finder
            [4] collect scatterplot and values
          source_cutoff: Supplementary Fig9 states Rr>0.5 indicates colocalization
          panel_scope: TAGLN/α-SMA, Supplementary Fig9b
        source_refs:

            locator: Sec26

            locator: PDF p.10
        missing_information:

        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [5]         step_id: A126-P005-S05
        title: CD68 到血管的空间距离
        action: 来源 Fig.6 将 α-SMA/IsolectinB4 血管生成 surfaces、CD68 生成 spots，计算 spot 到 surface 的最短距离和不同距离处累计 spot 数。
        parameters: 
          vascular_surfaces: 
            [1] α-SMA
            [2] Isolectin B4
          cell_spots: CD68
          distance: shortest spot-to-surface distance
          output: cumulative spot count at different distances
          branch_level: vascular filaments color coded from primary arteries to capillaries
        source_refs:

            locator: Sec7

            locator: Sec24
          [3]             source_id: F03
            locator: PDF p.10

        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [6]         step_id: A126-P005-S06
        title: 厚度与血管–轴突读出
        action: 按图7 的 Tag1/Laminin/DAPI 图像记录作者所称锥细胞相关层厚度占比；图8 用血管与轴突面积作线性回归。Supplementary Fig10 另给界面数量和面积。

          layer_ratio: cone-associated layer thickness / retinal thickness, Fig7
          vascular_axon: vessel/axon signal areas, Fig8b
          regression: linear regression, n=5 per Fig8 caption
          interface_scope: Supplementary Fig10c/d, n=3
        source_refs:

            locator: Sec8
